gates.name: Provenance
gates.detail: Every graded game traces to a saved NFL.com by-week page; all 136 results reconcile with the official standings snapshot on W-L-T, PF and PA.

gates.name: No leakage
gates.detail: Forecast for week w uses only weeks < w; the board is built inside the loop.

gates.name: Executable price
gates.detail: No sportsbook price was retrieved, so ROI, CLV and edge-as-money cannot be computed. This gate cannot pass and is never counted as one.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.detail: 120 graded bets against a floor of 100.

gates.name: Accuracy beats the null model
gates.detail: Skill score vs the home-field-only null on margin: +0.0487.

gates.name: Statistical significance
gates.detail: Exact binomial p = 0.0012 under pure chance.

gates.name: Multiplicity control
gates.detail: Benjamini-Hochberg q = 0.0220 at a 10% false-discovery ceiling.

gates.name: Stability across halves
gates.detail: First half 0.583 vs second half 0.700.

gates.name: Survives out of sample
gates.detail: Out-of-sample hit rate 0.642.

gates.name: Rights and release
gates.detail: NFL.com terms do not permit releasing a compiled dataset or a systematic feed. Nothing is released; the competition can be scored but not commercialised.

leaderboard.name: Originated board (directional)
leaderboard.reward_withheld_because: RG03 (no executable price) and RG10 (no release rights) are blocked; a reward cannot be justified without a price to settle against.

leaderboard_empty_because: No entry reached the qualified tier, which requires an executable price. Provisional entries are published for review and receive no reward.

luck_analysis.interpretation: The best record in the family (at least 20 bets, so that a 5-1 start is not mistaken for an edge) is reported against the chance rate for that same number of bets, and against the chance rate for the whole family. If the family-wise figure is not small, the spread of results across strategies is what luck looks like when many strategies are tested, not evidence of skill.

leg_dependence.note: Leg dependence is measured on the originated board, not on a sportsbook line. It answers 'how do my own two legs move together', which is what priding a parlay off my own numbers requires. It is not a market edge.

not_measured.why_blank: Per-player per-game logs were not retrieved in this session, so no joint distribution of two player props can be estimated.
not_measured.how_to_close: Read the official game log on https://www.nfl.com/players/ for each player in a prop pair and record the same-game values.

not_measured.why_blank: No sportsbook price was retrieved and none is licensed.
not_measured.how_to_close: A licensed odds feed with documented redistribution rights.

not_measured.why_blank: The availability desk publishes week-10 statuses, but the scored weeks 1-9 have no saved injury snapshot, so a like-for-like adjustment cannot be fitted without inventing one.
not_measured.how_to_close: Archive each week's official injury report before kickoff.
